body.name: input-determined start and supported-context transition
body.construction:
The relation \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}}\) consists of the input-determined start and supported-context cases.  A \(\operatorname{Start}\) task mechanically constructs the LS-SWIG \(G^{+}(a,s_{\emptyset})\), computes
\[
 Y^{*}=\operatorname{an}_{G^{+}(a,s_{\emptyset})}(Y),
\]
canonically lists the districts of \(G^{+}_{Y^{*}}\), and replaces itself by their \(\operatorname{District}\) tasks and one dependent \(\operatorname{Join}\) task.  For the least pending \(D^{*}\), it computes
\[
 L(D^{*})=\{s\in H:\operatorname{laidback}(s,D^{*})
 \text{ and }s\text{ is compatible with }a_{\operatorname{spa}(D^{*})}\}.
\]
If this set is empty it records \(\operatorname{LGSFailPos}(D^{*})\) and creates the corresponding residual task.  Otherwise it stores the canonically ordered list \(L(D^{*})\).  Whenever a context is inspected, its graph is exactly the mechanically constructed \(G[s]\); initializing its kernel records the base ledger entry \(p_H(S=s)=\sum_vp_H(v,s)\).  No context outside \(H\), no published output, and no successful trace is inspected.
